sloka: अपनीयाश्रमाद्रामं यन्मृगच्छद्मना त्वया ।आनीता रामपत्नी सा तत्ते कातर्यलक्षणम् ।। ६.११४.६९ ।।
transliteration: apanīyāśramādrāmaṁ yanmṛgacchadmanā tvayā ।ānītā rāmapatnī sā tatte kātaryalakṣaṇam ।। 6.114.69 ।।

translations.english: "King! You have invaded the world by your brilliance and were proud of your heroism. How did you do this mean act of abducting a woman?"
